description: Worked feedback-record examples for AES-V2.5 routing (SUE-563). Each record validates against schemas/feedback-record.schema.json and routes cleanly under editorial/feedback-routing.json. Used by scripts/validate-routing.mjs and scripts/test-routing.mjs. Not part of the feedback/ registry — these are illustrative fixtures, never real feedback.

records.statement: This piece never actually argues anything — it restates the sources in order and there is no thesis a reader could disagree with.

routing.rationale: No falsifiable thesis and no connective argument; the source order became the article order. This is a frame failure, not a prose failure.

records.statement: The owner said 'this doesn't feel right' with no further detail and has not responded to a follow-up question.

routing.rationale: The complaint is too underspecified to distinguish an audience-fit failure from a composition failure from a brand-fit failure; naming a layer here would be a guess.

records.statement: For the third time this month the picked reference sample is technically on-topic but visually nothing like what we publish, specifically for the research register.

routing.rationale: The reference lookup for the research register consistently ranks topical similarity over craft fit; three independent instances now.

records.statement: This one output has garbled Korean text in the bottom-right label; everything else about the layout matches what we normally ship.

routing.rationale: No shared layer applies — this is not a publication-constraint failure, it is a modality-specific rendering defect. layer: null with abstained: false is not abstention: we know exactly what failed. A single mechanical text-rendering defect; nothing about the composition or brand tokens is implicated, and a re-render is expected to clear it.

records.statement: The citation next to the revenue figure resolves but is about a different fiscal year; it does not support the claim beside it.

routing.rationale: A phantom citation — resolves but does not support the specific claim. Routes to verify-claims, not to a prose fix.
